# opalstack_server (Data Source)

Looks up a server of the account by `id` or by `hostname`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_server" "web" {
  hostname = "opal1.opalstack.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the server, such as `opal1.opalstack.com`.
- `id` (String) UUID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `type` (String) Type of the server, as the API reports it.
